records.subject: Welcome aboard, Silver Analytics
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, zero activity: no project, no invite, no milestone, no tickets, and no reply to the welcome email [email:50ea38c6]. Fully silent accounts with 8 days left rarely self-activate; nothing signals intent.

draft.subject: A first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Following up on my welcome note from last week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating your first project is the step that makes everything else click 
colon the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. After that, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything about how your team works day to day.

Best,
Priya
